title: Enforce exact coverage threshold precision
rawUserRequest: The user requires discovered process defects to be fixed before dependent work continues and requires quality performance work to retain rigorous, non-misleading evidence.

declaredIntent.summary: Recover the archived hosted snapshot corrective by making the 85 percent coverage floor use explicit two-decimal comparison and by testing the actual pytest exit boundary.

outOfScope: Rounding sub-threshold coverage upward to pass
Changing the hosted snapshot implementation or its archived evidence; focused recovery coverage may test an existing fail-closed branch
Changing performance implementation, publishing a release, or weakening any other quality gate

sources.reason: The immediately preceding archived Work Item was incorrectly accepted after project-test logged 84.99 percent coverage below the declared floor.
The canonical project-test command declares the 85 percent floor consumed by pytest-cov.
Coverage run configuration currently omits report precision, so coverage.py compares the floor at default zero-decimal precision.
The existing regression checks only that --cov-fail-under=85 appears, not that a just-below-threshold result exits nonzero.

intent.problem: coverage.py rounds 84.994669 percent to 85 at its default precision zero, while pytest-cov prints a sub-threshold failure line but returns zero; the quality summary therefore reports PASS for evidence below the declared 85 percent floor.
constraints: Keep the floor at 85 and compare at two decimal places.
Prove the real pytest-cov process exits nonzero for a deterministic below-threshold fixture.
Preserve the preceding archive bytes and use the repository's documented adjacent recovery pair.
Do not claim the hosted snapshot corrective valid until recovery quality and hosted CI pass.
intent.rationale: Explicit precision plus an executable exit-code regression aligns human-visible coverage output, process status, and Gate evidence without increasing test scope or hiding uncovered code.

riskAssessment.reason: Coverage is a release-blocking quality claim and the recovery must preserve immutable predecessor evidence while tightening, not weakening, the gate.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized continuous corrective execution and required process defects to be fixed before performance resumes.

preReviewWarnings: Review the real subprocess exit-code regression rather than relying only on configuration text.

checkpointPolicy.reason: A release-blocking quality boundary and adjacent recovery require final-hash checkpoints.

acceptance: Coverage report precision is explicitly two decimal places while the fail-under floor remains 85.
A deterministic pytest-cov subprocess whose coverage is below 85 exits nonzero under repository configuration.
Existing Make project-test and quality entrypoints retain --cov-fail-under=85 and no gate is removed or skipped.
RFE-ISSUE-139 and traceability map the contradictory evidence, root cause, implementation, regression, and recovery lifecycle.

The recovery source-references the immediately preceding archived Contract, has explicit restricted-write approval, and archives at the next sequence so aggregate PR validation accepts only this adjacent pair.
Full quality passes at a true two-decimal coverage result of at least 85, followed by PR, hosted CI, merge, ai-close-work-item, branch cleanup, and synchronized main before performance resumes.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Measured coverage is 84.994669 percent with an 85 percent floor.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The pytest-cov subprocess exits nonzero instead of rounding to a passing integer.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run a temporary-module pytest-cov subprocess using repository pyproject.toml and assert nonzero below the floor.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Repository coverage is at least 85.00 percent under two-decimal precision.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Full project-test and quality pass with consistent output and exit evidence.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run full quality and inspect target/coverage.json plus project-test timing exitCode.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The recovery accidentally changes the predecessor archive or lowers/skips coverage.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Scope, immutable archive, Make regression, and aggregate PR checks reject the change.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Verify predecessor archive is unchanged, Make dry-run retains the floor, and check-ai-pr accepts exactly the adjacent pair.

guidelines: Test the actual coverage subprocess exit behavior, not only the presence of a command-line string.
Tighten comparison precision without lowering the floor or deleting tests.
Preserve immutable predecessor evidence and complete the adjacent recovery lifecycle before resuming performance.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user requires every discovered process problem to be solved before performance and release work continue.

rollbackNote: Revert the precision setting and regression only after restoring an equally strict, executable coverage boundary.
